name: routewise
description: RouteWise — a global, community-powered transport & mobility platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @routewise/api && npm run build -w @routewise/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @routewise/shared && npm run typecheck -w @routewise/api && npm run typecheck -w @routewise/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @routewise/api && npm run test -w @routewise/web
scripts.build:render: npm run build -w @routewise/api && VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build -w @routewise/web
scripts.setup:db: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
